description: Get the full price before your user orders: the items (price × quantity, at the agreed price with deal_id), shipping, sales tax and the total in USD, when the charge happens, and Egonex buyer protection (returns and refunds follow it). It only reads: nothing is ordered, reserved or charged. Pass offer_id for a new order, or request_id for an order already sent to the seller (when the seller accepts first: quote it once check_request shows ready_to_pay, right before the pay_order that charges). For an item that ships pass shipping_address; for other items, where Egonex adds sales tax, pass buyer_location. Egonex uses them only to calculate shipping and sales tax and doesn't store them. Returns a quote_id that lasts 15 minutes: pass it to request_order and pay_order, and get a payment token for exactly total. pay_order then charges exactly that total, or nothing when something changed or the quote expired (quote_changed / quote_expired): call quote_order again. Quotes that calculate sales tax are limited to 15 a minute for the same listing from the same client (slow_down). Errors end with their code in parentheses.

buyer_location.description: For an item that doesn't ship, where Egonex adds sales tax: the billing address of the card your user will pay with. pay_order calculates the tax from that card's billing address, so give the full address (street, city, state, ZIP code) when you can.

postal_code.description: ZIP or postal code; required in the US (12345 or 12345-6789).

state.description: State or region; for the US the 2-letter USPS code.

deal_id.description: With offer_id, optional: deal.id from an ask_seller answer in which Ego agreed a price with you for this listing.

offer_id.description: For a new order: the listing id from search_offers (the 8-character id at the end of a listing page URL also works).

quantity.description: With offer_id: how many units (items, hours, sessions...). Default 1.

request_id.description: Instead of offer_id, for an order already sent to the seller: the id from request_order. The quote is for that order as it was sent (its quantity and price).

shipping_address.description: For an item that ships: where your user wants it shipped, the same object you will pass to pay_order (the recipient's name isn't needed here).

postal_code.description: ZIP or postal code; for the US 12345 or 12345-6789.

state.description: State or region; for the US the 2-letter USPS code (for example CA).

variant_id.description: With offer_id, required for a listing with options (its variants): the id of the variant your user chose; the quote uses that variant's price.

name: quote_order

buyer_protection.description: Egonex buyer protection (returns and refunds always follow it).

charge.description: When the money is taken (charge_note says how).

charge_note.description: When the charge happens and what happens if the seller declines.

deal_id.description: The agreed price the quote uses (from ask_seller); absent without one.

quote_id.description: Pass it to request_order and pay_order before expires_at.

request_id.description: With request_id: the request whose order the quote is for (use it only with that request's pay_order).

sales_tax.description: Sales tax in USD (0 when sales_tax_collected is false).

sales_tax_collected.description: false = Egonex doesn't add sales tax to this order.

shipping.description: Shipping in USD, once per order (0 when it doesn't ship or ships free).

unit.description: What one unit is (as in the listing's price).

unit_price.description: USD per unit (the agreed price when the quote has deal_id).

variant.description: For a listing with options: the variant's values, e.g. Black / M.

variant_id.description: For a listing with options: the variant quoted; absent otherwise.

title: Get the full price before ordering
